date_semantics: ISO date, no timestamp or time zone conversion

customer_history.interval: valid_from <= placed_on AND (placed_on < valid_to OR valid_to IS NULL)

semantics.refund_amount: refund_cents is authoritative money; do not reconstruct it from returned quantity
semantics.paid_net: sum of paid order line amounts minus sum of returns belonging to paid orders
semantics.empty_order: preserve o16; zero additive amounts and NULL zero-denominator ratio
semantics.ratio: ratio of aggregate numerator to aggregate denominator; NULL when denominator is zero
semantics.temporal_overlap: multiple as-of matches block qualification; no winner rule is approved
semantics.current_segment: open-ended row only, intentionally different from historical as-of segment
semantics.local_filters: measure filters do not change the population seen by another measure
semantics.role_aliases: buyer and seller independently reference parties using their own keys

source_files_are: hand-authored challenge inputs, not generated answers or qualified native models
physical_bindings_are: planned synthetic bindings derived from fixture CSV headers, not native observations
